briefs: docs/round10/track-m2.md (read M20 and docs/round10/track-d0.md D0-2 and D0-3 first)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss) and the mob tracks M1 (land animals), M2 (this run: water mobs and buckets) and M3 (night, built mobs and horses), which all plug into D0's registry. Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. M2 edits only its own water group files (entities world/families/water*, world natural_spawner/families/water.rs, terrain families/water*) and the M2 section of docs/round10/mobs.md, plus the shared lines its brief names; every shared piece has one owner in the brief's M20 tables, so never build a copy of an M1, M3, E or W piece: if a group's M20 wait is not met in this branch, leave that group, note it in the log, and go on with the groups that do not need it. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. SINCE THE BRIEF (2026-11-03): m2a is merged (24d774f1: the water hooks, the water paths over NodeSource, mob buckets, squids and glow squids), and M1 m1a with "Registered Minecraft mobs can run their own AI step" (8ad4c103), so water-swimming may start. Also merged into minecraft-survival and in this branch: D0 d0b (flying navigation), E1, E2 e2b, F (Margit), M1 m1b (pandas: ClientFx.item_crumbs, family gifts, the rain and thunder hooks) and all of track W, including w3 (game events of mob equipment, doors and silverfish with helpers such as Body::equipment_changed in entities/src/world/game_events.rs): where vanilla posts a game event for something this segment builds (check with javap), post it through those helpers, one line per site. W brought WalkProfile.distance_xz, which the shared A* reads through NodeSource::profile(); keep it. Running alongside: M1 m1c (foxes), M3 (m3a's lightning and phantoms being merged, then m3b) and E3 e3a (a clippy baseline: minecraft_terrain takes the workspace lints). The scratchpad is shared with the other tracks: keep scratch files in a folder named track-m2 inside it. Commit through Git Bash or `git commit -F <file>` with a file written without a byte-order mark (PowerShell piping added one to d11758b3). Never merge anything into this branch; the orchestrator does. RESUME (written 2026-11-03 at about 05:10, when the owner stopped round 10 for the week): this run continues a segment stopped in the middle; the other tracks' state is in docs/PROGRESS.md 'Where it stands', so ignore the 'running alongside' lines above. If the worktree holds uncommitted or staged changes, read git status and git diff (and git diff --cached) first, keep what is correct and finish it. Never amend, rebase or rewrite history: an 'Unfinished:' WIP commit stays in history and its group is finished in new commits with the brief's subjects. Do not merge minecraft-survival into the branch; the orchestrator merges the finished segment at the end, so the review still uses git diff <base>..HEAD. The scratchpad is shared with other runs: keep scratch files in a folder named for this track inside it. Commit through Git Bash or `git commit -F <file>` with a file written without a byte-order mark (PowerShell piping adds one). Done before the stop: water-swimming (8f50a80f, 815102c8).

groups.prompt: RESUME: 2b598c3c 'Unfinished: Minecraft cod, salmon, tropical fish and pufferfish swim in the entity world' is commit 1, staged and logged by its run (its log entry records 37 water tests and 700 entities lib tests passing and a green launcher check); it was committed as unfinished only because the stop killed the last rerun of the fish tests.
